name: All Star Varsity Jackets
description: All Star Embroidery's WordPress/WooCommerce varsity jacket system with school browsing, multiple jacket styles per school, responsive image galleries, structured ZIP/CSV imports, live Gutenberg blocks, and WooCommerce product tools.
changelog:
1.0.3

  • Fixed tablet and phone jacket-detail images overflowing the gallery by containing media and capping viewport height.
  • Added Customize Jacket beside View Jacket Details, with style changes updating the correct WooCommerce link.
  • Made the popup CTA sticky at the bottom and included the starting price.
  • Gallery clicks now open the selected photo, with improved active-thumbnail styling.
  • Mobile action buttons now use an even two-button row.
